data: What is the approximate maximum value achieved by distance?

The question asks for the approximate maximum value achieved by the distance. From the caption, we know that the two lines represent the baseline and dist values. The y-axis represents the average topic distance, which ranges from approximately 0.00 to 0.30. The red dashed line (dist) shows more variation than the black solid line (baseline). The highest point on the red dashed line appears to be around 0.30. Therefore, the approximate maximum value achieved by the distance is 0.30.
